reviewer: Root author, not independent or blinded
source_protocol: Reason over literal visible paragraphs and ordinary reference resolution. No external factual lookup, future answer, or hidden decomposition binding may supply a missing premise. Multiple supported answer paths are allowed. Hard labels are masked when the reviewer cannot resolve the input; masked is not a declaration the official answer is false.
partial_policy: Before pool-relative exhausted, allow opening explicitly grounded partial premises. Unanswerable does not automatically mean immediateSTOP.

train_selection.role: train-only source review pilot, not a new heldout cohort
train_selection.selection_rule: First positive source family per available support-group count in frozen C20order, then first remaining positive families until4. Metadata-only selection before reviewing source text. All paired source rows included.
train_selection.initial_selection_note: Attempted2/3/4strata had no4-support row and ended before writing any selection. No source text was inspected in that failed metadata selection.

dev_selection: Four alreadyexposed families targeted from earlier failure/alternative reviews; seven rows, not a representative noise-rate estimate.
